statements.text: The Chinese government just launched the first-ever AI-powered cyber attack against our country that we know of. At the same time, President Trump is selling the powerful H200 Nvidia chips, the next generation chips, to China. [...] Why in the world, given that they just did this, what, a couple months ago, would we be giving them these next generation chips now? At the very least, we ought to be holding them back until we have some way of verifying that these chips are not going to be used to attack us.
statements.context: House committee hearing on quantum, AI, and cloud cybersecurity, where the congressman presses expert witnesses on the national-security implications of exporting advanced AI chips to China.
